leadText: Volume 4 is the fourth volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of Shogakukan's collected releases of the magazine version.
plainText:
Volume 4 is the fourth volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of Shogakukan's collected releases of the magazine version.

==Blurb==
Casey and Henry’s journey through the Galar region continues! Casey is finally reunited with another of her missing Pokémon! Will she be able to find all of them?

And can Henry win the challenge against Allister?!

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==
Adventure 11: Gulp!! Gulp Pokémon
Adventure 12: Thump!! The Gazing Sage
Adventure 13: Glittering!! The Tapestry in the Vault
